descriptionDecision.actualAfterDe: Die lernende Person kann an Beispielen Unterschiede zwischen Individuen derselben Art beschreiben und erläutern, dass solche Unterschiede auch in neuen Generationen ohne vorgegebenes Entwicklungsziel auftreten.
descriptionDecision.actualAfterEn: The learner can use examples to describe differences between individuals of the same species and explain that such differences also occur in new generations without a predetermined developmental aim.
descriptionDecision.reason: Explicitly describes individual differences and explains nonpurposeful variation in new generations, retaining one integrated class6 goal. New DE/EN titles also reflect explanation. Prerequisite, scope and source-boundary metadata unchanged.
